summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2006-7 filed an 8-K disclosing an affiliate of depositor Navient Funding's bidding plans for two auction-rate note auctions: a September 16, 2026 auction for $27.75M Class A-6B Notes, where the affiliate holds 100% and will submit a Hold Order, and a September 18, 2026 auction for $27.75M Class A-6C Notes, where the affiliate holds $27.70M and intends to buy remaining unheld notes at 30-day Average SOFR + 1.50%. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The mechanics amount to an affiliate-supported auction-rate securities backstop, effectively a synthetic issuer tender supporting failed auctions.
